senses.gloss: ch. same, to perforale. Part. pass. חֲרִים, חָרִים flat-nosed, v. preced.

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 6:18">Targ. Josh. VI, 18</cite> <he>תְחַרְמוּן</he> (Var. <he>תַחַרְ׳</he>, read: <he>תַחְרְ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 15:21">Targ. I Sam. XV, 21</cite> <he>די חַרְמוּן</he> (ed. Lag. a. oth. <he>דיַחְרְמוּן</he>).—

<cite ref="Arakhin 28a:61">Arakh. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>כל דאית ליה לא לַחְרֵים … ליחַרְמֵיה כוליה</he> one must not renounce (for sacred purposes) all his property, but of one kind he may renounce all he has.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:6">M. Kat. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מנלן דמַחְרְמִינָן</he> (or <he>דמְחַרְמִי׳</he>) whence is it proven that we (the court) have a right to excommunicate a recreant person?—Y. ib. III, 81ᵈ top <he>אילולא דלא חַרְמִית … מְחַרֵם וכ׳</he> were it not that I never in my life excommunicated a person, I should have excommunicated that man; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְחַרַם</he>, pl. <he>מְחַרְמִין</he>. Ib. bot. <he>ייא ההוא גברא מ׳</he> this man (thou) be excommunicated.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ליהוון ההיא עמא מח׳</he> those people (you) be excommunicated.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 27:29">Targ. O. Lev. XXVII, 29</cite> <he>דיִתְחֲ׳</he> ed. Berl. (oth. <he>דיִתַּחֲ׳</he>).
